concerns.text: FR-001 (GEO download & sample‑count requirement) has no associated task in tasks.md; no task mentions downloading GEO series or checking the ≥ 50 sample threshold.
FR-002 (normalization method choice) is not covered by any task; there is no task that implements VST or TPM normalization or the TPM‑Spearman branch.
FR-003 (CPM filtering & variance‑based gene selection) lacks a dedicated task; no task describes CPM filtering or the deferred‑gene‑count selection.

FR-004 (correlation computation & threshold lower bound) is not linked to any task; the threshold‑validation task T012 exists but does not reference FR-004, and no task enforces the ≥ 0.75 lower bound.
FR-005 (gene‑to‑STRING identifier mapping) has no matching task; the mapping script T017 exists but is not tagged with FR‑005.
FR-06 (full‑set evaluation against STRING) is not covered; no task mentions scoring all raw correlations or generating balanced negative sets.
FR-007 (degree‑preserving random‑graph baseline) is missing; there is no task that builds or validates a baseline graph.
FR-008 (GO enrichment of predicted interactome) is not linked to any task; the enrichment script T027 exists but lacks an FR‑008 tag.
FR-009 (Makefile orchestration & 6‑hour runtime) has no explicit task; no task validates the overall runtime budget.
FR-010 (JSON‑Line pipeline logging) is not covered; logger implementation T006 exists but is not tied to FR‑010, and schema‑validation tasks for the log are missing.
FR-011 (predicted edge‑list file format) lacks a task that verifies column names or writes the file according to the schema.
FR-012 (global seed flag) is not referenced by any task; the CLI validator T012 exists but does not enforce seed propagation across all modules.
FR-013 (schema validation of predicted edge list) has no task; T010 creates schema files but no task validates predicted_ppi.tsv against them.
FR-014 (batch‑effect correction & confound regression) is not covered; tasks T065/T065a exist but are not linked to FR‑014 and lack QC abort on > 5 % residual variance.
FR-015 (gene‑filtering & variance‑based sub‑selection) is missing; no task documents the CPM filter or the deferred‑gene‑count selection.
FR-016 (balanced negative sampling for evaluation) is not covered; task T091 implements sampling but is not tagged with FR‑016.
FR-017 (post‑target verification of all required outputs) has no overarching verification task; T011c is mentioned in the analysis report but not present in tasks.md.
FR-018 (baseline_p field in evaluation_metrics.json) is not linked to any task; no task records or validates this field.
FR-019 (evaluation_metrics.json schema validation) lacks a task; T143 exists in the plan but is absent from tasks.md.
FR-020 (retain raw correlation scores for unbiased AUROC/AUPRC) is not covered; no task ensures raw_correlations_*.tsv.gz is written before thresholding.
FR-021 (per‑species summary report) has no dedicated task; T126 exists in the plan but is missing from tasks.md.
FR-022 (report top enriched GO terms) is not linked to any task.
FR-023 (graceful handling of no significant GO terms) lacks a task; no task specifies writing the “No significant enrichment” line.
FR-024 (save raw correlation scores) is not covered; no task mentions persisting raw_correlations_*.tsv.gz.
FR-025 (threshold‑sensitivity analysis) is missing; tasks T085/T086 exist in the plan but are absent from tasks.md.
FR-026 (construct‑validity justification with literature citations) has no task; T128 (citation block) is not present in tasks.md.
FR-028 (final aggregated report) is not covered; tasks T127/T138 are missing.
FR-030 (threshold‑sensitivity TSV schema validation) lacks a task; T086 is not listed.
FR-032 (negative‑sampling strategy definition) is not linked to any task; T091 implements sampling but without an FR‑032 tag.
FR-034 (pipeline log schema conformity) has no task; T010g creates the schema but no task validates log entries.
FR-035 (record command‑line, versions, seed in log) is not covered; logger extension T098 is mentioned in the plan but absent from tasks.md.
FR-045 (edge inclusion based solely on correlation threshold) is not linked to any task; no task asserts that adjusted p‑values do not affect edge selection.
FR-047 (abort on < 50 retained samples) has no task; no task checks total sample count after series‑level filtering.
FR-048 (pilot benchmark on held‑out dataset) is missing; task T148 is not present.
SC-001 (AUROC ≥ 0.70 & AUPRC ≥ 0.70) is not tied to any verification task; no CI test asserts these thresholds.
SC-002 (at least one GO term with adjusted p < 0.05) lacks a CI check; no task validates GO enrichment output against this criterion.
SC-003 (pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) is not covered; no task records or fails on exceeding the wall‑clock limit.
SC-004 (reproducibility with identical seed) has no task that compares output checksums across runs.
SC-005 (post‑target verification of required files) is not represented; no task runs a verification script after each Make target.
SC-006 (schema‑validation steps must all pass) lacks a consolidated task; individual schema checks are missing from tasks.md.
The 'Run the full pipeline' step in quickstart.md is not linked to any task; there is no task that orchestrates the full Make workflow.
The 'Verify outputs' step in quickstart.md has no corresponding task; no task runs the make verify target.
Data‑model entity 'RNASeqSample' is not covered by any task; no task creates or processes this entity.
Data‑model entity 'Gene' is not linked to any task; gene filtering and variance calculation are not task‑tagged.
Entity 'RawCorrelation' lacks a task; correlation computation and storage are not associated with a task.
Entity 'ProteinCorrelation' is not covered; identifier mapping tasks do not reference this entity.
Entity 'PredictedEdge' has no task; edge‑list export is not linked to a task.
Entity 'EvaluationMetric' is not covered; evaluation script tasks do not reference this entity.
Entity 'GOEnrichmentRecord' lacks a task; GO enrichment script is not tied to this entity.
Entity 'ThresholdSensitivityRecord' is not covered; sensitivity analysis tasks are missing.
Entity 'PipelineLogEntry' has no task; logging tasks do not reference this schema.
Contract file 'predicted_ppi.schema.yaml' is not linked to any task; no task validates predicted edge files against this schema.
Contract 'evaluation.schema.yaml' lacks a task; no task validates evaluation_metrics.json.
Contract 'threshold_sensitivity.schema.yaml' is not covered; no task validates the sensitivity TSV.
Contract 'pipeline_log.schema.yaml' has no associated task; log schema validation is missing.
